intro: Convert liters per minute (L/min, or LPM) to US gallons per minute (GPM) accurately for water pump selection, irrigation zones, hydraulic circuits, and commercial plumbing specs. Because 1 US liquid gallon equals exactly 3.785411784 liters, each LPM to GPM conversion divides L/min by 3.785411784 (1 L/min = 0.264172 US GPM). Scan common pump flow rates from 1 L/min to 1,000 L/min below.

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: US GPM (3.785 L/min) vs. UK Imperial GPM (4.546 L/min) & Gas SLPM
items: US liquid GPM uses the 3.78541 L gallon (1 L/min = 0.26417 US GPM), whereas British Imperial GPM uses the 4.54609 L gallon (1 L/min = 0.21997 UK GPM)—a 20.1% difference on imported pump curves.

Volumetric L/min to GPM applies directly to incompressible liquids like water and oil; for compressed air or welding shielding gas, confirm whether your flowmeter reads actual L/min or standard SLPM corrected for pressure and temperature.

faqs.question: How many US GPM are in 1 L/min (LPM)?
faqs.answer: 1 liter per minute equals 0.264172 US gallons per minute (about 0.2642 GPM). Conversely, 1 US GPM equals 3.78541 liters per minute.

faqs.question: How do I convert LPM to GPM (US)?
faqs.answer: Divide the flow rate in liters per minute by 3.785411784 (or multiply by 0.26417205): GPM = L/min ÷ 3.785411784. For example, 10 L/min = 2.64172 US GPM.

faqs.question: What are 30 L/min and 40 L/min in US GPM?
faqs.answer: 30 L/min equals 7.92516 US GPM (about 7.93 GPM), and 40 L/min equals 10.56688 US GPM (about 10.57 GPM).

faqs.question: Is US GPM different from UK Imperial GPM?
faqs.answer: Yes—1 US GPM equals 3.78541 L/min, while 1 UK Imperial GPM equals 4.54609 L/min (about 20% larger). Always verify whether pump datasheets specify US GPM or Imp GPM.
